query:
UPDATE machines SET 
  image2DUrl = CASE 
    WHEN name LIKE '%AVI%' THEN '/machines/avi-machine-1.jpg'
    WHEN name LIKE '%AOI%' THEN '/machines/aoi-machine-1.jpg'
    ELSE image2DUrl
  END,
  image3DUrl = CASE 
    WHEN name LIKE '%AVI%' THEN '/machines/avi-3d.jpg'
    WHEN name LIKE '%AOI%' THEN '/machines/aoi-3d.webp'
    ELSE image3DUrl
  END;
